final_evaluation_unsupported_query_polic: report separately as a coverage/failure slice; never silently omit
final_gallery_policy: a larger gallery is locked until independent evaluation ends

graded_relevance.1: same official articleType but different baseColour

limitation: metadata grades are a proxy, not human visual-similarity ground truth
query_exclusion_reason: articleType is outside the train-fitted supported slice

recall_at_k.caller_requirement: pass an explicit total relevant count or complete gallery relevance vector
recall_at_k.denominator: all distinct grade-2 product IDs in the allowed train gallery
recall_at_k.numerator: distinct grade-2 product IDs among the first K product IDs
recall_at_k.zero_positive_query_rule: exclude from macro Recall@K and report in coverage

self_match_policy: remove every query product ID before product-level Top-K
variant_policy: encode both image variants; rank by the best variant score; collapse to one product ID before Top-K and product-level scoring
